Kansas City’s KSHB 41 News provides coverage of important news and events across both sides of the state line in Kansas and Missouri, offering stories about people making a difference in the community. 

We keep our community in the know with the latest weather and traffic.

We know how much Kansas Citians love sports, so our coverage includes the Chiefs, Royals, Sporting KC, the KC Current, KU, MU, K-State and high school sports.
